description: One depositor’s vault positions with their accounting: per position the status (verified, estimated, opening balance unknown, share transfer unresolved, …) and why, the combined result only where verified or estimated, realised and unrealised by weighted-average cost where the share ledger was read, the result in the vault’s own asset, a period result where shares were held before our history (never a lifetime one), and provenance (history start, block, price source, methodology version). Unknown is null, never zero. FREE.
